utter_deferment_info.text:
📋 **Deferment (Leave of Absence)**

**Procedure:**
1. Get deferment form from Faculty
2. Submit with supporting documents
3. Obtain Dean's approval

**Deadline:** Before Week 3 of semester
**Duration:** Maximum 2 semesters

⚠️ May affect PTPTN/scholarships. Contact Student Affairs for details.

utter_change_program.text:
🔄 **Changing Program/Major**

**Requirements:**
• Minimum CGPA (usually 2.5+)
• Completed at least 1 semester
• Available slots in target program

**Procedure:**
1. Get application form from Registry
2. Get approval from both faculties
3. Submit before deadline

💡 Credits may transfer depending on course equivalence.

utter_repeat_policy.text:
📚 **Repeat/Failed Subject Policy**

**Key Points:**
• Failed subjects must be repeated
• Core subjects: Must repeat immediately when offered
• Maximum grade after repeat: Usually capped (check faculty rules)

**GPA Impact:**
• Both grades may appear on transcript
• Latest attempt used for CGPA calculation

⚠️ Repeated failures may lead to probation.

utter_grade_appeal.text:
📝 **Grade Appeal/Review**

**Procedure:**
1. Submit appeal form to Faculty
2. Pay review fee (varies)
3. Wait for recheck result

**Deadline:** Usually 2 weeks after results release

**Note:** Appeal may result in same, higher, or lower grade.

💡 Consult your lecturer first before formal appeal.

utter_probation_info.text:
⚠️ **Academic Probation**

**Status Levels:**
• **P1:** CGPA 1.50 - 1.99 (1st warning)
• **P2:** Still below 2.00 after P1
• **P3:** Still below 2.00 after P2
• **Dismissed:** After P3 if CGPA still below 2.00

**Requirements During Probation:**
• Limited credit hours (usually max 15)
• Must maintain minimum semester GPA

💡 Seek help from academic advisor immediately!

utter_credit_transfer.text:
📋 **Credit Transfer/Exemption**

**Eligible For:**
• Diploma graduates
• Transfer students from other universities

**Procedure:**
1. Submit exemption form with transcript
2. Provide syllabus of previous courses
3. Faculty evaluates equivalence

**Limits:** Usually max 30% of program credits

⚠️ Apply within first semester of enrollment.

utter_elective_options.text:
📚 **Elective Courses**

**Types:**
• **Program Electives:** Within your field
• **Faculty Electives:** Any course in faculty
• **University Electives:** Any faculty (limited)

**Popular Categories:**
• Language courses (Japanese, Mandarin, etc.)
• Entrepreneurship
• Sports & Recreation

💡 Check SMP for available electives each semester.

utter_industrial_training.text:
🏢 **Industrial Training (LI)**

**Requirements:**
• Usually in Year 3 or 4
• Minimum credits completed (check program)
• Must not be on probation

**Duration:** 12-16 weeks (varies by program)

**Procedure:**
1. Attend LI briefing session
2. Find and apply to companies
3. Submit placement confirmation
4. Complete LI report and logbook

💡 Start searching for placement 6 months early!

utter_convocation_info.text:
🎓 **Convocation/Graduation Ceremony**

**Registration:**
• Done through SMP portal
• Usually opens 2 months before ceremony

**Requirements:**
• Complete all graduation requirements
• Clear all outstanding fees
• Register within deadline

**Attire:**
• Rent graduation robe from appointed vendor
• Follow dress code guidelines

**Guest Tickets:**
• Usually 2-4 tickets per graduate
• Additional tickets may be available

🎉 Congratulations on reaching this milestone!

utter_career_prospects.text:
💼 **Career Prospects (Computer Science)**

**Popular Career Paths:**
• Software Developer/Engineer
• Data Scientist/Analyst
• Cybersecurity Specialist
• Web/Mobile Developer
• Cloud/DevOps Engineer
• AI/ML Engineer

**Industries:**
• Tech companies (Google, Microsoft, etc.)
• Banking & Finance
• E-commerce
• Government agencies
• Startups

**Demand:** High - CS graduates are in demand globally!

💡 Build projects and get certifications to stand out.

utter_mental_health_support.text:
💚 **We're Here For You**

I'm sorry you're going through a difficult time. Your wellbeing matters.

**Immediate Support:**
📞 **Malaysia Mental Health Line:** 03-2935 9935
📞 **Befrienders:** 03-7956 8145 (24 hours)

**UPM Resources:**
• **Counseling Services:** Pusat Kaunseling UPM
• **Location:** Bangunan Hal Ehwal Pelajar
• **Hours:** Mon-Fri, 8am-5pm

**Remember:**
• It's okay to ask for help
• Taking a break is okay
• You are not alone

❤️ Please reach out to someone - a friend, family, or counselor.

utter_fees_block.text:
💰 **Registration Block (Fees)**

**Reasons for Block:**
• Outstanding tuition fees
• Payment not yet processed

**To Unblock:**
1. Pay minimum required amount
2. Upload payment proof to SMP
3. Wait 24-48 hours for system update

💡 Contact Bursary if payment not reflected after 3 days.

utter_class_full.text:
📚 **Full Class/Section**

**Options:**
• Try other available sections
• Check during add/drop period (seats may open)
• Request quota increase from lecturer

**Procedure for Quota Request:**
1. Email lecturer with justification
2. If approved, get signed form
3. Submit to Faculty office

⚠️ No guarantee of approval - have backup subjects ready.

utter_timetable_clash.text:
📅 **Timetable Clash**

**Solutions:**
• Switch to different section of one subject
• Drop one subject and take it next semester
• Request special arrangement (rare)

**Tips:**
• Plan your registration early
• Have backup sections ready
• Check timetable before finalizing

⚠️ Attending both clashing classes is NOT allowed.

utter_system_issues.text:
🖥️ **System/Portal Issues**

**Common Solutions:**
• Clear browser cache
• Try different browser (Chrome recommended)
• Check if system is under maintenance

**Password Reset:**
• Use "Forgot Password" on login page
• Contact IT Helpdesk if still unable

📞 **IT Helpdesk:** Contact your faculty's IT support

💡 Try during off-peak hours (early morning/late night).

utter_verification_letter.text:
📄 **Student Verification Letter**

**Types Available:**
• Enrollment confirmation
• Active student status
• For PTPTN/scholarship/bank

**How to Get:**
1. Login to SMP portal
2. Go to "Surat Pengesahan" section
3. Download and print

**For Custom Letters:**
Contact Registry/Faculty office with specific requirements.

utter_exam_schedule.text:
📅 **Exam Schedule**

**How to Check:**
1. Login to SMP portal
2. Go to "Jadual Peperiksaan"
3. View your personalized exam timetable

**Includes:**
• Date and time
• Venue/Hall
• Seat number

⚠️ Timetable usually released 2-3 weeks before exams.

utter_exam_regulations.text:
📋 **Exam Regulations**

**Dress Code:**
• Formal/smart casual attire
• No slippers, shorts, or sleeveless

**Must Bring:**
• Student ID card (matric card)
• Stationery (pens, pencils)
• Calculator (if permitted)

**NOT Allowed:**
• Mobile phones (must be OFF and stored)
• Notes/books (unless open book exam)

⚠️ Arrive 30 mins early. Late entry may be denied.

utter_deans_list.text:
🏆 **Dean's List (Anugerah Dekan)**

**Requirements:**
• Semester GPA: 3.50 or above
• No failed subjects that semester
• Minimum credit hours (usually 12+)

**Benefits:**
• Certificate from Dean
• Recognition in academic records
• Some faculties offer monetary rewards

💡 Aim high every semester - it looks great on your resume!

utter_muet_requirement.text:
📝 **MUET Requirement**

**Minimum Band for Graduation:**
• Most programs: Band 3
• Some programs: Band 4 (check with faculty)

**If Below Requirement:**
• Must retake MUET before graduation
• Register through Malaysian Examination Council

**Alternatives (Some Programs):**
• IELTS (minimum score varies)
• TOEFL (check equivalency)

💡 Take MUET early so you have time to retake if needed!

utter_registration_deadline.text:
📅 **Course Registration Deadlines**

**Add/Drop Period:** Usually Week 1-2 of semester

**Important Notes:**
• Check SMP portal for exact dates each semester
• Late registration may incur penalties
• Ensure fees are paid to avoid registration block

💡 Visit the Academic Calendar on UPM website for current dates.

utter_drop_course.text:
📋 **Dropping/Withdrawing from a Course**

**Procedure:**
1. Apply through SMP portal
2. Get advisor's approval
3. Submit before deadline

**Types of Withdrawal:**
• **Week 1-2:** Full refund, no record
• **Week 3-7:** Partial refund, "W" grade
• **After Week 7:** No refund, may affect GPA

⚠️ Dropping courses may affect PTPTN/scholarship eligibility.

utter_graduation_requirements.text:
🎓 **Graduation Requirements**

**Credit Hours:** 120-130 credits (varies by program)

**Minimum CGPA:** 2.00

**Required Components:**
• Complete all core subjects
• Complete electives requirement
• Pass Final Year Project (FYP)
• Meet MUET Band requirement
• Complete Industrial Training (LI)

💡 Check with your faculty for program-specific requirements.
